title: Autonom App Profile v1
description: The document in .autonom/apps/<app-id>/profile.yaml (workspace, read first) or $AUTONOM_HOME/apps/<app-id>/profile.yaml (home), written in the flow files' YAML subset, so every value is a string. A profile never holds a secret: secret-named fields and accounts hold environment variable NAMES only, and any credential-shaped value is refused with profile_invalid. Flow paths are relative to the profile's folder.

login_flow.description: Flow v1 file run first by 'pretest warmup'.

warmup_flow.description: Flow v1 file run after login_flow passed.

accounts.description: Account name -> one environment variable name, or field -> variable name. 'pretest warmup' hands the variables that are set to the flows as secrets.

fixtures.description: Free-form test data (no secrets): a mapping or a list of strings, lists and mappings.

flaky_screens.description: Screen ids or labels known to be flaky.

events.description: Analytics rules matched by 'pretest events'; names are unique.

env_name.description: An environment variable name starting with AUTONOM_ or PRETEST_; warm-up reads no other variable.

host.description: Exact host or a glob such as *.example.com, any letter case.

path.description: Glob over the request path without its query.

body_key.description: Top-level JSON key, dotted path into nested JSON, or a form field.

body_value.description: The value at body_key, compared as text (JSON true is "true").
